parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels joined together to create the outer shell.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports all other parts such as shelves, base, and door.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire cabinet together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom panel of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing stability and support for the structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and ensures the cabinet stands evenly on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is a horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood, used for supporting stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space and provides a surface for placing objects.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is another horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood, used for organizing stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space and helps organize contents vertically.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but remains stationary during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the frame with hinges, featuring a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, providing access to the cabinet interior.
